children: In today’s rapidly developing Bangalore, lifts are a crucial part of modern infrastructure, serving residential, commercial, and industrial buildings. Choosing the right lift manufacturer ensures durability, safety, and efficient performance for years to come.
, we are one of the most trusted lift manufacturers in Bangalore, providing tailor-made lift solutions with high-quality materials, cutting-edge technology, and reliable service.

We design and manufacture a range of lifts suited to different needs:
– Safe and efficient transport for residential and commercial buildings.
– Compact and stylish for private residences.

– Heavy-duty lifts for industrial and commercial use.

How BG Elevators Works as a Lift Manufacturer
– Creating designs tailored to the project.

Areas We Manufacture and Supply Lifts in Bangalore
Q1. What types of lifts do you manufacture?
We manufacture passenger, home, hospital, goods, hydraulic, and MRL lifts.
Q2. How long does it take to manufacture and install a lift?
Typically, manufacturing and installation take 6–10 weeks depending on the type and customization.
Q3. Do you offer warranty and maintenance services?
Yes, all lifts come with warranties and AMC options.
Yes, BG Elevators specializes in custom lifts to meet specific building needs.
